body: Can AI make Software Engineering (SE) -- the discipline -- obsolete? And can it make software engineers -- the professionals -- redundant? This paper argues that the rise of capable AI coding agents makes SE and software engineers essential, not obsolete: the missing foundation without which AI-assisted development produces misleadingly plausible, unverifiable, and ultimately untrustworthy software. Three structural properties of large language models (probabilistic generation, agnosticism, and semantic statelessness) create a structural vacuum that no amount of training can eliminate. Filling it requires four knowledge levers: methodological knowledge, domain knowledge, design choices, and process choices. All four must be reified as persistent artifacts, and each requires the software engineer as methodologist, mediator, and custodian.
summaryZh: 本文探讨了AI编码代理对软件工程学科及从业者的影响。作者认为，大模型固有的概率生成、不可知论和语义无状态性导致了结构性真空，使得AI生成的代码往往难以验证且不可信。因此，软件工程不仅不会被淘汰，反而成为AI辅助开发中不可或缺的基石。文章提出，人类工程师需通过方法论知识、领域知识、设计决策和过程决策这四大杠杆，将AI产出转化为可靠的软件制品，在开发流程中扮演方法论专家、调解者和守护者的角色。
